original_test_intent: Measure each approved GPU PCIe path with nvqual and verify throughput meets a topology/speed/width-specific numeric floor while link integrity and platform health remain stable.
original_method: Verify artifact provenance/checksum/compatibility and pin wrapper; map GPU BDF through bridges/root ports, record capabilities and negotiated speed/width; define direction, size, iterations/concurrency and bandwidth floors; baseline AER/errors, clocks, thermals and power; drain workloads, preserve logs, run once with monitoring, evaluate raw samples and restore links/services.
manual_activity: PCIe/performance owner approves artifact, transfer workload and topology-specific bandwidth floors; operator isolates workloads and owns thermal/power/link recovery.
required_inputs: Exact nvqual version/provenance/checksum/license and stack compatibility
Per-path bandwidth floors/tolerance and integrity rules
safety_requirements: Do not infer numeric bandwidth limits
Preserve raw samples and link/error logs
agent_execution_scope: Evaluate every path/sample/subtest and telemetry delta
Restore health and report without verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate raw per-path throughput samples with negotiated speed/width, transfer parameters and explicit floors while checking AER/integrity and platform telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds artifact trust, numeric oracle, path attribution, workload definition and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A harness PASS alone cannot detect a material bandwidth regression.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Link/memory saturation can disrupt workloads, retrain/downgrade links, raise errors or overheat/power-stress the platform.

project_override_considerations: Performance engineering must define expected unidirectional/bidirectional throughput, units, efficiency ratio, warmup/sample aggregation and topology-specific tolerance.
expected_evidence: Transfer parameters plus raw bandwidth samples/units

independent_technical_reasoning: Bandwidth depends on negotiated generation/width, direction, transfer size, concurrency, clocks and topology.
